source.title: Adjutant General (AG) Corps (Career Management Field 42) Career Progression Plan
source.proponent: Commandant, Adjutant General School (Personnel and Leader Development Division), Fort Jackson, SC
source.notes: Date basis: the 30 Sep 2025 date comes from the official file name and the Army G-1 listing (https://www.army.mil/g-1), checked 2026-10-15. The PDF body prints no date. The official download is byte-identical (same SHA-256) to the copy supplied by the project owner. This edition also contains MOS 42R/42S/42T chapters, which are NOT imported here. A separate CMF 42T/79 publication dated 9 Sep 2026 is listed on G-1 and may supersede the 42T chapter of this edition.

occupations_note: Only MOS 42A is imported from this document.

1.reason: CMF-wide overview. It also describes Army Bands and recruiting, so it is not attached to 42A.

2.reason: CMF-wide transformation overview, not attached to 42A.

3.mapping_note: Chapter 3 is general CMF 42 career guidance by rank. It is attached to 42A (an HR-oriented chapter) as a mapping decision that a reviewer should confirm.

5.reason: Points to the Professional Development Model on the Army G-1 website; contains no guidance text.

defaultSkipReason: Other MOS (42R musician, 42S special bands, 42T talent acquisition): out of scope for 42A.
